images.note: Beat: Pearl Harbor attack (Dec 7, 1941) — the lesson's climax. Primary is the exact 'famous photo of the explosion, the fireball going straight up' the script names: Official U.S. Navy photograph, 'USS Arizona, at height of fire, following Japanese aerial attack on Pearl Harbor, Hawaii' (LOC item 92500933), 4096x3267 master TIF. Alt is a DIFFERENT image from a DIFFERENT institution: U.S. Navy Photo 100-1, 'Japanese sneak attack damages West Virginia and Tennessee and sinks Arizona' (National WWII Museum accession 2010.523.022), 3600x3045 JPEG. Both contemporary, Dec 7 1941.
images.title: USS Arizona exploding during the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor, December 7, 1941

images.note: Beat: 'a date which will live in infamy' — Dec 8, 1941 address to Congress asking for war declaration (the lesson's self-test Q1). FDR Library photo NPx 48-22:307, contemporary Dec 8 1941, 1200x878 JPEG (source maxes at 1200px wide — exactly at bar). alt_url is null: the FDR Library is the sole accessible institutional source for this event's photography from this VM. NARA holds the original but its catalog API is unreachable (returns SPA HTML); LOC's only infamy-day-adjacent photo (cph.3a17434) is actually the Dec 11 Germany declaration signing — wrong beat, rejected; a 1945 newspaper halftone was rejected as non-contemporary.
images.source: Franklin D. Roosevelt Presidential Library and Museum (via Google Arts & Culture)
images.title: FDR delivering the 'Day of Infamy' speech to Congress, December 8, 1941

images.note: Beat: Nye Committee (1934-36) 'merchants of death' hearings that fueled isolationism and the Neutrality Acts. Harris & Ewing portrait of Gerald P. Nye (LOC item 2016890245), 1932 — contemporary of the hearings (1934-36), 3958x5109 master TIF. Honest caveat: portrait of the chairman, not the hearings in session. alt_url is null: Hagley's du Pont hearing photos are bot-walled (challenge page); Senate.gov's Nye portrait is low-res (<1200px); LOC service derivatives are <1200px. No second institution qualifies at bar.
